$comment: The spec's own worked example, posted through money-flows 1a to 1d. These exact numbers are proven by supabase/tests/database/28_ledger_test.sql. If an app ever computes a different total from the same inputs, the app is wrong.

zero_exponent_currency.$comment: UGX has exponent 0. 12500 is USh 12,500, not USh 125.00. A hardcoded /100 corrupts this, which is how M3.20 happened.

invariants: Entries in a transaction sum to zero.
Balances are derived, never stored as truth.
A promo never reduces provider earnings: commission stays on the full negotiated price and the discount is platform_promo_expense.
No commission on the item float: the customer covers the gateway fee on it so the provider is reimbursed exactly what they spent (OD-04).
